post.title: California Christmas markets 2026: save the dates

slides.pip: Every date checked on each market's own site.

slides.label: Santa Ynez Valley
slides.dates: Nov 27 to Jan 3 · Solvang Park and village
pips: Light and music shows in Solvang Park, nightly 5 to 9.
Tree lighting Fri Dec 4 at 5:30, parade Sat Dec 5 at 11.

slides.label: Central Coast
slides.dates: Cambria Pines Lodge · Nov 27 to Dec 31 · select nights, 5 to 9 PM
pips: 3 million lights, a train ride and visits from Santa.
Sold-out nights don't sell at the door; weeknights are calmer.
slides.photo_note: Photo: the lodge's lounge on a 1930s postcard

slides.label: Bay Area · Daly City
slides.kicker: 5 weekends · Nov 21 to Dec 20, plus Nov 27
lines: Victorian London inside the Cow Palace: over 4 acres of lanes, theatres and shops.
Tickets are date-specific and sold online only.
slides.pip: A miniature steam train meets you at 'Victoria Station'.

slides.label: Orange County · Huntington Beach
slides.dates: Old World Village · Nov 15 to Jan 3
pips: Icicle lights and green-and-red stalls, built into the village.
Hours aren't announced yet: check before you drive.

slides.label: Kids will love
items: With a train ride and visits from Santa
Clue sheets at the Visitor Center, all season
Then chimney-sweep school, and maybe a bronze coin
slides.pip: New Year's at 3 PM: Solvang's Copenhagen Countdown, Dec 31.

items: Cambria's sold-out nights don't sell at the door; tickets are online only.
The Dickens Fair is weekends only, plus Nov 27, with date-specific tickets.

post.tiktok_desc: Save the dates: 4 California Christmas markets for 2026, from Huntington Beach to Daly City. Every date checked Nov 10, 2026.
dropped: Phoenix Club Christkindlmarkt: the club left Anaheim in 2022; no 2026 market found
Sacramento Turn Verein Christkindlmarkt: no 2026 date announced yet
Carmel Christkindlmarkt: it's in Carmel, Indiana, not California
Cambria closed dates: shown only as a graphic calendar on the market's site

notes.window: Nov 10 to Dec 5, 2026 (most useful before Thanksgiving)
recheck: Old World Christmas Markt hours (TBA on Nov 10).
Cambria calendar: which nights are hotel guests only.
Dickens Fair Children's Tour page for 2026.

sources: Solvang Julefest 2026 (official visitor site): Nov 27, 2026 to Jan 3, 2027; nightly light & music shows in Solvang Park at 5, 6, 7, 8 and 9 PM; Nisser Adventure clues at the Solvang Visitor Center; Tree Lighting Fri Dec 4, 5:30 PM; parade Sat Dec 5, 11 AM; Copenhagen Countdown Thu Dec 31, countdown at 3 PM

Cambria Christmas Market (official): Nov 27 - Dec 31, 2026, select dates, 5 PM - 9 PM, 2905 Burton Dr, Cambria (Cambria Pines Lodge); 3 million twinkling lights, a German-inspired artisan vendor market, visits from Santa, a train ride, fire pits, live music; cashless
Cambria Christmas Market FAQ: tickets are sold only through the official website; sold-out dates are not sold at the door; 'we recommend visiting on a weeknight to skip the crowds'

The Great Dickens Christmas Fair (official): 5 weekends, 10 AM - 6 PM, Nov 21 - Dec 20, 2026, plus the Friday after Thanksgiving; over 4 acres of the Cow Palace exhibition halls turned into Victorian London
Dickens Fair FAQ: tickets only through dickensfair.com; tickets are date-specific and daily attendance is limited; no on-site ticket sales at the Cow Palace

Dickens Fair, Children's Tour of London: a miniature steam train at the Fair's 'Victoria Station'; a chimney sweep training school where kids may receive a bronze collectible coin (tour text linked to the 2025 PDF)

Simply German USA (a shop at Old World Village, oldworldhb.com contact): 'Christmas Markt 2026', Old World Village, Huntington Beach, Nov 15, 2026 to Jan 3, 2027; hours 'To be announced'; icicle lights and green-and-red market stall canopies
Old World Huntington Beach (official): 7561 Center Ave, Huntington Beach; Old World Restaurant & Biergarten
